capabilities: record audio via microphone and transcribe it with OpenAI Speech-to-Text
insert, append, or copy transcribed text into the active note
configure recognition language and UI language independently (ja/en/zh/ko)
clean up transcriptions with optional dictionary-based post-processing
auto-save in-progress drafts and restore them on reopen
extras: Desktop-only (Windows/macOS), requires Obsidian 1.8.0+, OpenAI API usage is billed, optional local VAD requires manually installing fvad.wasm, and the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README is duplicated in Japanese.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in speech-to-text dictation, so users who want to capture notes by voice must use outside tools and paste results manually.

relations.evidence: Capture notes with high-accuracy multilingual voice input using OpenAI Speech-to-Text.
download fvad.wasm from the fvad‑wasm project and place it in the same plugin folder

requires.name: fvad.wasm file (for optional local voice activity detection)

summary: Voice dictation plugin that records microphone audio, transcribes it with OpenAI GPT-4o models, and inserts the text into notes.
